description: N/A rules for FPA (FP&A) pillar questions. Questions listed here will show an N/A button during assessment.

na_rules.rationale: Working capital assumptions (DSO, DIO, DPO) modeling may be handled by Treasury or Operations in some organizations.
Covenant forecasting only applies to companies with debt obligations. Companies without debt have no covenant compliance requirements.
Cash flow and liquidity projection may be handled by Treasury rather than FP&A in some organizations.
Direct method (13-week) cash forecasting is optional for stable, debt-free companies. These organizations may use simpler cash management approaches.
